tracking: ADR-0345 §9 slice 3b: the jurisdiction admin APIs; the jurisdictions screen and the use-case geography panel belong to a design builder and are posted on #453

gaps.GET /v1/jurisdictions: lists the jurisdictions with their obligations (paged)
gaps.PATCH /v1/jurisdictions/:code: renames a jurisdiction or changes its parent or global flag; narrowing needs a settings_relax step-up
gaps.DELETE /v1/jurisdictions/:code: removes a jurisdiction no use case or child names, with its obligations; needs a settings_relax step-up
gaps.POST /v1/jurisdictions/:code/obligations: adds an obligation citing a live ADR-0158 feed entry for this jurisdiction
gaps.PATCH /v1/jurisdictions/obligations/:obl: changes an obligation's tier floor; lowering or clearing it needs a settings_relax step-up
gaps.DELETE /v1/jurisdictions/obligations/:ob: removes an obligation; needs a settings_relax step-up
gaps.GET /v1/use-cases/:useCaseId/jurisdictio: shows a use case's declared jurisdictions and what they resolve to (scope, obligations, tier floor)
gaps.PUT /v1/use-cases/:useCaseId/jurisdictio: replaces a use case's declared jurisdictions; a change that narrows its scope needs a settings_relax step-up
